scope: Fresh installed archive export compared field by field against all 35 runtime weapons and both authored modes.
fieldCoverage: primary and alternate recoil seeds, angle, variance, magnitude, magnitude variance
stance, movement, firing, jump, initial jump, apex and landing inaccuracy
initial and final stand/crouch recovery and transition bullets
spread, cycle, speed, deploy and reload attack lock
damage, penetration, range, range modifier, armor ratio and headshot multiplier
zoom levels, FOV and duration; burst and revolver flags; ammo/reserve/pellet controls

Current cfg and gameinfo text files do not supply recoil smoothing/suppression or most movement/accuracy convar defaults. Existing native server console log directly establishes six movement defaults.
Native command seed derivation and JavaScript trigonometric float parity remain unverified.
Ladder inaccuracy and Negev firing-movement factor activation remain unverified; no speculative changes made.
Zeus falloff and knife/backstab arithmetic remain explicit approximations; the prior hitgroup/armor selector verification does not prove complete damage arithmetic.
